title: Galvanic body-coupled channel: population model and simulator

creators.name: Ormanis, Juris
creators.affiliation: Institute of Electronics and Computer Science

description: Generative population model of the galvanic body-coupled communication channel at the 50 Ohm receiver termination, 0.6-20 MHz, for network simulation. Gain of a link = mean layer + body term (shared by the links of one body) + link term, in the mean-plus-spread form of the radio channels of the IEEE 802.15.6 channel-model document. The mean layer is the population-mean table plus a site term set by the typical circumferences of the two electrode sites, so any pair of the twelve measured sites can be drawn; a reference mean measured elsewhere can replace the table. The body term and the link term are normal, each with a four-eigencurve covariance over frequency. Fitted on 521 links of 30 participants and tested on persons left out of the fit. Contains the parameter table (params.json), a Python generator that draws bodies (popmodel.py), its test, and the Castalia/OMNeT++ export script. The repository also holds the coexistence simulator with its tests and its model checking. It holds scripts: no measurements and no results. The only data files are the parameter tables the code starts from. The measurements are the open dataset at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.8214497.
